title: On the de Rham cohomology of algebraic varieties
first_circulation: Letter to Atiyah 14 October 1963; notes except note13 November1963, as stated in paper
result_used: Algebraic de Rham comparison; historical period question, including distinction between individual transcendence and algebraic independence.

title: Hodge’s general conjecture is false for trivial reasons
locator: Printed299–300, §§1–2; local PDF pages1–2 actually viewed
result_used: Naive rational intersection with a Hodge filtration need not be a Hodge substructure; corrected formulation uses the largest sub-Hodge structure. The manuscript index remains ambiguous.

title: Théorie de Hodge II
result_used: Mixed-Hodge/Tate conventions; fixed-part theorem and one-fibre extension of a global H¹ integral-local-system morphism between abelian schemes.

title: Hodge cycles on abelian varieties
authors: Pierre Deligne, notes by James Milne
result_used: Betti, étale, de Rham comparisons, real conjugations and Tate structures; CM endomorphism criterion. Algebraic de Rham and rational Betti structures are distinct.

title: Tannakian Categories
locator: Theorem3.2; Example3.8; Proposition2.23; Theorems4.17,4.27,4.29; Definition5.1; Propositions6.22–6.25 and footnote21
result_used: Fibre functor/torsor formalism, reductivity, real polarization and grading. The connectedness assertion in6.22(a)/6.23(a) has an absolute-Hodge hypothesis added in the correction.

title: Arithmetic subgroups of algebraic groups
locator: Theorem6.9, printed510–511; surrounding pp507–511 actually viewed from local PDF
result_used: Finite arithmetic orbits of integral points on a closed orbit in a rational representation of a reductive Q-group; application to fibre functors requires additional reduction.

title: Arithmetic subgroups of algebraic groups
result_used: Earlier announcement of arithmetic-group results; used for chronology, not a replacement for1962 closed-orbit theorem.

title: Conjugate varieties with distinct real cohomology algebras
publication: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik630 (2009),125–139
locator: Theorem1/introduction; author bibliography and arXiv0706.3674 submission history checked
result_used: Existence of a number-field smooth projective variety and two complex embeddings with different real cohomology algebras; no prescribed-pair universal statement.

title: p-adic interpolation of real analytic Eisenstein series
result_used: CM makes the de Rham Hodge splitting algebraic; the converse is posed as a question.

title: Fonctions modulaires et indépendance algébrique
result_used: Equivalent analytic formulation of Katz’s splitting question; historical backward reference to Chudnovsky.

title: Some remarks concerning the Grothendieck period conjecture
publication: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik714 (2016),175–208
result_used: Smallest generated torsor versus Zariski locus of the period point; full conjecture for CM elliptic curves; cycle-class normalization with convention-dependent sign.

title: De Rham–Betti classes with coefficients
authors: Tobias Kreutz, Mingmin Shen and Charles Vial
publication: Preprint, no publication verified for version3
locator: Proposition3.1 and Remark3.2, pp8–9; Theorems5.12–5.13, pp19–20; introduction
result_used: Generated algebraic torsor equals appropriate de Rham–Betti torsor over Qbar; elliptic product results. These are not the full arithmetic period conjecture for a non-CM elliptic curve.

title: Construction des représentations p-adiques semi-stables
result_used: Weakly admissible filtered (phi,N)-modules correspond to semistable p-adic representations over a complete discretely valued characteristic-zero field with perfect residue field; N=0 gives crystalline. Not an integral motivic essential-image theorem.

title: The first de Rham cohomology group and Dieudonné modules
first_circulation: Harvard dissertation June1967, acknowledged in paper
result_used: Contravariant Dieudonné anti-equivalence and H¹ de Rham of an abelian variety over a perfect field, with Hodge sequence. For general smooth proper X with X(k) nonempty, Corollary5.12 gives only the stated injection from DM of the p-kernel of Pic_X.

title: An abelian category of motivic sheaves
result_used: Semisimple pure motivic local systems and André comparison; realization fullness in abelian-type cases. Algebraic-correspondence Hodge conjectures remain a separate issue.

title: Galois descent for motivic theories
publication: Theory and Applications of Categories44, no20 (2025),588–616
result_used: Galois descent for specified rational motivic categories including Nori motives; not a theorem identifying arbitrary integral or crystalline fibre functors.

title: A comparison of motivic Galois groups
locator: Theorem9.1, p40; fixed complex embedding in setup
result_used: Comparison of Nori and Ayoub motivic Galois groups; does not identify homological correspondences with algebraic cycles.

title: Introduction to Shimura Varieties
first_circulation: Clay lectures2003 as stated by author
publication: Harmonic Analysis, the Trace Formula, and Shimura Varieties, Clay Mathematics Proceedings4 (2005),265–378; expanded notes
result_used: Polarizable integral Hodge structures of abelian type recover abelian varieties; rational structures recover them only up to isogeny; relative version for abelian schemes.

title: Quaternion Algebras, Chapter42: Supersingular elliptic curves
first_circulation: Book first version history not audited
result_used: Geometric endomorphism algebra of a supersingular elliptic curve is the quaternion algebra ramified at p and infinity, giving a real two-dimensional realization obstruction.

title: Lectures on Lie groups over local fields
result_used: Finite-dimensional p-adic Lie groups: continuous homomorphisms analytic; closed subgroups and Hausdorff quotients are p-adic Lie groups.

title: Lie Algebras, Algebraic Groups, and Lie Groups
locator: §5 Casimir and Weyl complete reducibility; §8.1–8.27 Cartan results; §9.1–9.3 highest weights; root-system classification §7
result_used: Established finite-dimensional characteristic-zero Lie results; precise split/algebraically-closed hypotheses and the author’s Fitting definition of regularity are essential.

title: Motives, numerical equivalence, and semi-simplicity
result_used: Semisimplicity characterizes numerical equivalence; not unconditional equality of homological and numerical equivalence.

title: Functional transcendence of periods and the geometric André–Grothendieck period conjecture
first_circulation: arXiv2208.05182 first posted10 August2022; publisher version separately checked
publication: Forum of Mathematics Sigma13 (2025),e97; published23 June2025; DOI10.1017/fms.2025.10036
result_used: Function-field relative period transcendence theorem, with constants C; does not settle arithmetic elliptic period algebraic independence. Arc paths give a related Betti comparison for finitely generated regular extensions, not the manuscript’s arbitrary countable geometric tower.

title: Théorie des intersections et théorème de Riemann–Roch, Exposé X, appendix
authors: Alexander Grothendieck, in SGA6 edited with Pierre Berthelot and Luc Illusie
first_circulation: Seminar1966–1967; earlier multigraph version acknowledged in preface
locator: §7.13, printed576–579 and581 viewed; printed580 missing from this PDF
result_used: Primary verification of rational Chern-character specialization and beginning/end of7.13.11. Integral square on missing580 is not yet verified from this scan; manuscript18/007 supplies its wording.

title: Basic representation theory
locator: Theorem1.20 and proof pp7–9; Proposition1.21; Remark1.24; Lemma1.28; Example1.39 and Proposition1.40
result_used: Haar covering-number proof, uniqueness and modular conventions; close mathematical match to reused manuscript pages. Not proof of an archival genealogical relationship.

title: Invariant measures on homogeneous spaces
locator: Theorem2 and equation3b, p1; Theorem4, p2
result_used: Haar existence/uniqueness and determinant modular character; the convention is inverse to the manuscript pullback convention.

title: Harish-Chandra isomorphism, maximal quotients
result_used: Harish-Chandra centre/shifted-Weyl invariants and highest-weight central characters; the archive does not specify all proposed formulas for W(lambda).

title: Integration II: Haar Measure
first_circulation: French original date not verified in the opened preview
result_used: Publication lead; exact results verified instead in Li’s full proof. No inaccessible page is treated as read.

title: Cohomological characterization of CM curves
locator: Question and comments, no answer displayed in opened page
result_used: Discovery/status lead for Katz’s de Rham splitting question; not a primary proof or an absence theorem.

title: Generalized Heegner cycles and p-adic Rankin L-series
authors: Massimo Bertolini, Henri Darmon and Kartik Prasanna
publication: Duke Mathematical Journal, published version on author webpage
result_used: CM eigenspace splitting of H¹ de Rham agrees with the complex Hodge splitting and ordinary p-adic unit-root splitting. Does not establish the converse.

title: Éléments de géométrie algébrique IV, troisième partie
locator: Theorem8.8.2, printed28–33; Scholie8.8.3,33; Theorem8.10.5,37–38; Theorem9.7.7,79–80. Original PDF downloaded and text read.
result_used: Descent of finitely presented schemes, morphisms, isomorphisms and finite diagrams through affine inverse limits; descent of the listed geometric properties and generic geometric connectedness after shrinking. No coherent infinite-diagram conclusion.

title: Données radicielles
first_circulation: SGA3 seminar1962–1964; exact original talk date not verified
publication: SGA3, ExposéXXI; modern author-edited reedition by Patrick Polo and Philippe Gille
result_used: Abstract root data and duality; root/coroot lattices and centres. This does not by itself fix analytic exponential normalizations.

title: Triality over schemes
publication: Preprint version opened; publisher DOI10.1007/s40879-024-00771-z not independently accessed
locator: TheoremA, introduction; Lemma2.1 and Corollary2.4, printed23
result_used: Explicit order-three triality on the split D4 groups over schemes. Historical introduction attributes triality to Cartan1925; the manuscript only assigns a topic.

title: Size of fundamental group
result_used: Weight and root lattices determine centre and fundamental group for compact connected semisimple groups; intermediate lattices classify global forms.

title: Reductive groups over fields
authors: Brian Conrad; notes by Tony Feng
result_used: Relative roots of a connected reductive group with respect to a maximal split torus form a possibly nonreduced root datum. This is separate from absolute reduced roots.

title: Lie Groups Beyond an Introduction
first_circulation: First edition1996; printed second edition2002; dates on copyright page
publication: Author digital edition of second edition
result_used: Restricted-root reflection construction and root-system theorem for real semisimple groups, allowing nonreduced systems; compact-group integral forms.

title: Mesure de Haar
publication: Séminaire de Mathématiques, Espace de Hilbert, tome2, exposé8,16 pages plus cover
locator: Opening; printed3–5, with the countability/metrizability scope retained
result_used: Primary historical witness to Haar measure before the manuscript; not used to claim an unrestricted general theorem beyond its explicit assumptions.

title: Formal schemes and formal groups
first_circulation: arXiv math/0011121 v1,17 November2000; earlier print chronology not verified here
result_used: Full faithful coalgebra-to-formal-scheme functor for coalgebras admitting a good basis, with inverse continuous dual on its image. Gives a precise qualified modern counterpart to the finite-chart argument.

title: Lectures on Lie Groups and Representations of Locally Compact Groups
authors: François Bruhat; notes by S. Ramanan
publication: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research Lectures14
result_used: Analytic unit-associative multiplication admits local inverses; formal group equations; modular function, semisimple unimodularity and coordinate Haar construction.

title: On universal enveloping algebras in a topological setting
first_circulation: arXiv1402.0186 v2,25 February2014; v1 chronology not independently checked
result_used: Point-supported distributions correspond to invariant local operators; explicitly recovers the classical finite-dimensional Lie-group case. Does not erase finite-differentiability order bounds.

title: Non-Associative Local Lie Groups
date: 2003 publication identified by discovery search; PDF itself undated
result_used: Exact four-pair local associativity axiom and restriction examples. Global associativity is a separate property, not inferred from the manuscript definition.

title: Endomorphisms of abelian varieties over finite fields
first_circulation: Earlier special elliptic case due to Deuring, discussed in introduction; no preprint date verified
result_used: Integral Hom comparison for abelian varieties over a finite field and l different from the characteristic. This is not the general Tate conjecture for all algebraic cycles.

title: Endlichkeitssätze für abelsche Varietäten über Zahlkörpern
result_used: Semisimplicity and Tate-module End/Hom comparison for abelian varieties over number fields; no centre-freeness or nonlinear section theorem follows.

title: The local pro-p anabelian geometry of curves
result_used: Dominant morphisms from smooth pro-varieties to hyperbolic pro-curves over sub-p-adic fields correspond to open Galois-compatible homomorphisms modulo geometric inner automorphisms. Used only to assess the earlier-run project analogy.

title: On cuspidal sections of algebraic fundamental groups
first_circulation: Dated24 February2012 on first page; filename20120802
locator: Definition26, p10; Definition29 and Theorem30, p11
result_used: Non-Tate hypothesis and cyclotomically normalized pro-l subgroups characterize cuspidal inertia in the stated setting. Procyclicity or an arithmetic-open normalizer alone is insufficient.

title: The absolute anabelian geometry of hyperbolic curves
date: 2004 bibliographic year in the supplied note; exact volume publication record not separately opened
publication: Author PDF of the chapter in Galois Theory and Modular Forms
result_used: Geometric hyperbolic fundamental groups in characteristic zero are slim; arithmetic slimness additionally uses a slim absolute Galois group. The outer action recovers the extension by pullback. This is independent of motivic semisimplicity.

title: The real section conjecture and Smith’s fixed-point theorem for pro-spaces
publication: Journal of the London Mathematical Society83 (2011),353–367; published online13 January2011, DOI10.1112/jlms/jdq075
locator: Notation1.1, Definition1.2 and Theorem1.3, pp1–2; proof p14; publisher metadata separately opened
result_used: For smooth geometrically connected projective real X satisfying the stated (Sigma,2)-erasability condition, components of X(R) correspond to conjugacy classes of pro-Sigma sections, with2∈Sigma. The hyperbolic projective curve case is covered; this does not distinguish individual points.
